title.zh: 卷111 志八十六 选举六 考绩
title.en: Volume 111 Treatises 86: Selection and Examinations 6, Kao Ji
title.raw: 卷111 志八十六 选举六 考绩

sentences.zh: 志八十六

translations.literal: Treatise Eighty-Six
translations.idiomatic: Treatise 86

sentences.zh: 選舉六

translations.literal: Selection and Examinations Six
translations.idiomatic: Selection and Examinations, Part 6

sentences.zh: 考績

translations.literal: Performance Evaluation
translations.idiomatic: Performance Evaluation

sentences.zh: 三載考績之法，昉自唐、虞。

translations.literal: The method of triennial performance evaluation originated in the Tang of Yao and the Yu of Shun.
translations.idiomatic: The practice of evaluating officials every three years began in the age of Yao and Shun.

sentences.zh: 清沿明制，而品式略殊。

translations.literal: The Qing followed the Ming system, but the grades and forms differed somewhat.
translations.idiomatic: The Qing adopted the Ming framework, though the ranks and procedures differed in detail.

sentences.zh: 京官曰京察，外官曰大計，吏部考功司掌之。

translations.literal: For capital officials it was called the capital inspection; for outer officials, the grand assessment; the Ministry of Personnel's Department of Merit Evaluation administered it.
translations.idiomatic: Capital officials underwent the capital inspection; provincial officials underwent the grand assessment. Both were managed by the Merit Evaluation Department of the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 京察以子卯午酉歲，部院司員由長官考覈，校以四格，懸「才、守、政、年」為鵠。

translations.literal: The capital inspection was held in the years of zi, mao, wu, and you; department and bureau clerks were examined by their superiors, checked against four criteria, with talent, integrity, administration, and age taken as the standard.
translations.idiomatic: The capital inspection was conducted in the years of the Rat, Rabbit, Horse, and Rooster. Department and bureau staff were rated by their superiors against four standards—talent, integrity, governance, and age.

sentences.zh: 分稱職、勤職、供職三等。

translations.literal: They were divided into three grades: competent, diligent, and dutiful.
translations.idiomatic: Ratings were divided into three grades: competent, diligent, and dutiful service.

sentences.zh: 列一等者，加級記名，則加考引見備外用。

translations.literal: Those listed in the first grade received rank advancement and name registration; after additional examination and audience, they were held in reserve for outside appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Those placed in the first grade received a step in rank and were registered by name; after further review and imperial audience, they were held ready for appointment outside the capital.

sentences.zh: 糾以六法，不謹、罷輭者革職，浮躁、才力不及者降調，年老、有疾者休致，註考送部。

translations.literal: They were impeached by the six categories of misconduct: the careless and the weak were dismissed; the flighty and those whose talent fell short were demoted or transferred; the aged and the ill were retired; evaluation records were sent to the ministry.
translations.idiomatic: Misconduct was judged under the six penalty categories: the careless and ineffectual were dismissed; the impetuous and those lacking ability were demoted or transferred; the elderly and infirm were retired; and evaluation records were forwarded to the ministry.

sentences.zh: 自翰、詹、科、道外，依次過堂。

translations.literal: Apart from the Hanlin Academy, the Imperial Academy, the Censorate, and the circuit intendants, all passed in turn before the evaluation hall.
translations.idiomatic: Except for the Hanlin Academy, the Imperial Academy, the Censorate, and circuit intendants, officials were examined in turn before the evaluation hall.

sentences.zh: 三品京堂由部開列事實，四、五品由王、大臣分別等第，具奏引見取上裁。

translations.literal: Third-rank capital officials had facts listed by their ministry; fourth- and fifth-rank officials had grades assigned separately by princes and grand ministers, memorialized for audience, and subject to the throne's decision.
translations.idiomatic: Third-rank capital officials were evaluated on factual reports submitted by their ministries. Fourth- and fifth-rank officials were graded by princes and grand ministers, presented in memorial for imperial audience, and left to the emperor's final judgment.

sentences.zh: 大計以寅已申亥歲，先期籓、臬、道、府遞察其屬賢否，申之督、撫，督、撫覈其事狀，註考繕冊送部覆覈。

translations.literal: The grand assessment was held in the years of yin, si, shen, and hai; beforehand the provincial administration commissioners, circuit intendants, prefects, and magistrates successively inspected the merit of their subordinates and reported to the governor-general and governor; the governor-general and governor verified the facts, entered evaluations, compiled registers, and sent them to the ministry for review.
translations.idiomatic: The grand assessment was conducted in the years of the Tiger, Snake, Monkey, and Boar. In advance, provincial commissioners, circuit intendants, prefects, and magistrates successively reviewed their subordinates and reported upward to the governor-general and governor, who verified the facts, recorded evaluations, compiled registers, and sent them to the ministry for final review.

sentences.zh: 才守俱優者，舉以卓異。

translations.literal: Those excellent in both talent and integrity were recommended as outstanding.
translations.idiomatic: Those distinguished in both talent and integrity were recommended as outstanding performers.

sentences.zh: 劣者，劾以六法。

translations.literal: The inferior were impeached under the six categories.
translations.idiomatic: The deficient were impeached under the six penalty categories.

sentences.zh: 不入舉劾者為平等。

translations.literal: Those neither recommended nor impeached were classed as ordinary.
translations.idiomatic: Those neither commended nor impeached were rated as ordinary.

sentences.zh: 卓異官自知縣而上，皆引見候旨。

translations.literal: Outstanding officials from magistrates upward were all presented for audience to await the imperial decree.
translations.idiomatic: Outstanding officials from the rank of magistrate upward were all presented for imperial audience to await the throne's decision.

sentences.zh: 六法處分如京察，貪酷者特參。

translations.literal: Disposition under the six categories was as in the capital inspection; the greedy and cruel were specially impeached.
translations.idiomatic: Penalties under the six categories followed the same rules as the capital inspection, while the greedy and cruel were specially impeached.

sentences.zh: 凡京察一等、大計卓異有定額，京官七而一，筆帖式八而一，道、府、廳、州、縣十五而一，佐雜、教官百三十而一，以是為率。

translations.literal: In general, first-grade capital inspection and grand-assessment outstanding ratings had fixed quotas: one in seven capital officials, one in eight clerks, one in fifteen circuit, prefectural, department, subprefectural, and county officials, and one in one hundred thirty assistant and educational officials—this was the standard ratio.
translations.idiomatic: Quotas were fixed for first-grade capital inspection and for outstanding grand-assessment ratings: one in seven capital officials, one in eight clerks, one in fifteen circuit, prefectural, department, subprefectural, and county officials, and one in one hundred thirty assistant and educational officers—ratios that served as the general rule.

sentences.zh: 非歷俸滿者，未及年限者，革職留任或錢糧未完者，滿官不射布靶、不諳清語者，均不得膺上考。

translations.literal: Those who had not completed a full salary term, those not yet at term, those dismissed but retained or with grain and tax accounts unfinished, and Manchu officials who could not shoot the cloth target or did not know the Manchu language were all ineligible for top ratings.
translations.idiomatic: Those who had not completed a full term of service, those not yet eligible by seniority, those dismissed but retained in post or with tax accounts still unsettled, and Manchu officials who could not pass the archery test or did not know Manchu were all barred from top ratings.

sentences.zh: 其大較也。

translations.literal: This was the general outline.
translations.idiomatic: Such was the general framework.

sentences.zh: 順治八年，京察始著為令，以六年為期。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Shunzhi, the capital inspection was first established as statute, on a six-year cycle.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Shunzhi (1651), the capital inspection was first codified, with a six-year cycle.

sentences.zh: 十三年，吏部奏定則例，三品以上自陳，四品等官吏部、都察院察考議奏，親定去留。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, the Ministry of Personnel memorialized fixed regulations: third rank and above submitted self-criticism; fourth rank and below were examined by the Ministry of Personnel and the Censorate, deliberated in memorial, and the emperor personally decided retention or removal.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year (1656), the Ministry of Personnel submitted fixed regulations: officials of third rank and above offered self-criticism; fourth rank and below were examined by the Ministry of Personnel and the Censorate, deliberated in memorial, and the emperor personally decided who would stay or go.

sentences.zh: 筆帖式照有職官例一體考察。

translations.literal: Clerks were examined together under the same rules as regular officials.
translations.idiomatic: Clerks were examined under the same rules as regular officials with substantive posts.

sentences.zh: 遇京察時，各官暫停升轉。

translations.literal: When the capital inspection occurred, all officials temporarily halted promotion and transfer.
translations.idiomatic: During the capital inspection, promotions and transfers were suspended for all officials.

sentences.zh: 尋復定考滿議敘例，三年考滿與六年察典並行。

translations.literal: Soon regulations on triennial completion and merit deliberation were restored; triennial completion and the six-year inspection cycle ran in parallel.
translations.idiomatic: Regulations on triennial completion and merit deliberation were soon restored, so triennial completion reviews ran alongside the six-year inspection cycle.

sentences.zh: 十七年，從左都御史魏裔介請，行糾拾之法，以補甄別所未及。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, following the request of Left Censor-in-Chief Wei Yijie, the method of supplementary impeachment was instituted to cover what formal screening had missed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year (1660), at the request of Left Censor-in-Chief Wei Yijie, a supplementary impeachment procedure was introduced to catch cases formal screening had missed.

sentences.zh: 唐熙元年罷京察，專用三年考滿例。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tangxi, the capital inspection was abolished and only the triennial completion rule was used.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Kangxi reign, the capital inspection was abolished and only the triennial completion rule was used.

sentences.zh: 三品以上仍自陳。

translations.literal: Third rank and above still submitted self-criticism.
translations.idiomatic: Officials of third rank and above still submitted self-criticism.

sentences.zh: 餘官分五等：一等稱職者紀錄，二等稱職者賞賚，平常者留任，不及者降調，不稱職者革職。

translations.literal: The remaining officials were divided into five grades: first-grade competent received record; second-grade competent received reward; ordinary remained in post; those falling short were demoted or transferred; incompetent were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Other officials were divided into five grades: first-grade competent officers were recorded for merit; second-grade competent officers received rewards; ordinary performers remained in post; those falling short were demoted or transferred; and the incompetent were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 三年，御史季振宜請停考滿三疏，極言徇情鑽營，章奏繁擾，無裨勸懲。

translations.literal: In the third year, Censor Ji Zhenyi memorialized three times to stop triennial completion, strongly arguing that favoritism and scheming prevailed, memorials were numerous and disruptive, and it did no good for encouragement and punishment.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, Censor Ji Zhenyi submitted three memorials urging an end to triennial completion, arguing forcefully that favoritism and careerist scheming dominated the process, that paperwork was excessive and disruptive, and that the system did nothing to reward merit or punish failure.

sentences.zh: 因停考滿自陳例。

translations.literal: Accordingly the triennial completion self-criticism rule was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The self-criticism procedure tied to triennial completion was therefore abolished.

sentences.zh: 六年，復行京察。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, the capital inspection was restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, the capital inspection was restored.

sentences.zh: 明年，甄別不及官三十七員。

translations.literal: The next year, thirty-seven officials who failed screening were removed.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, thirty-seven officials who failed screening were removed from office.

sentences.zh: 嗣以各部、院甄別司員，類多末職，二十三年，嚴諭指名題參，復甄汰王三省等三十六人。

translations.literal: Thereafter, as departments and bureaus screened clerks, most were low-ranking posts; in the twenty-third year a stern edict named persons for impeachment, and Wang Sansheng and thirty-five others were again screened out.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, when departments and bureaus screened their clerks, they mostly targeted junior posts. In the twenty-third year, a stern edict required officials to be named and impeached by name, and Wang Sansheng and thirty-five others were screened out again.

sentences.zh: 明年，京察又停。

translations.literal: The next year, the capital inspection was again suspended.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, the capital inspection was suspended again.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年復舉行，改為三年，自是為定制。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng it was restored, changed to a three-year cycle, and thereafter became the fixed rule.
translations.idiomatic: It was restored in the first year of Yongzheng (1723), the cycle was shortened to three years, and this thereafter became the permanent rule.

sentences.zh: 初，京察一等無定額，康熙三年，御史張沖翼疏請以部、院員數之多寡定一、二等名數，以息奔競，從之。

translations.literal: At first the first grade of the capital inspection had no fixed quota. In the third year of Kangxi, Censor Zhang Chongyi memorialized that the numbers for first and second grades should be set according to the size of each department and bureau, to quell scrambling for favor; the request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Initially there was no fixed quota for first-grade capital inspection. In the third year of Kangxi (1664), Censor Zhang Chongyi proposed setting first- and second-grade numbers according to each department's and bureau's staff size, in order to curb frantic competition for ratings; the court approved his proposal.

sentences.zh: 乾隆間，部、院保送一等，或浮濫溢舊額，詔停兼部行走，仍歸本衙門另班聲敘，暨到任未滿半年，仍由原衙門註考等例。

translations.literal: During the Qianlong reign, departments and bureaus recommended first-grade candidates, sometimes overflowing the old quota; an edict stopped concurrent service in another ministry, required return to the home office for separate-class review, and provided that those in post less than half a year were still evaluated by their original office.
translations.idiomatic: During the Qianlong reign, departments and bureaus sometimes recommended so many first-grade candidates that quotas were exceeded. An edict ended concurrent service in another ministry, required officials to return to their home office for separate review, and ruled that those who had served less than half a year were still evaluated by their original office.

sentences.zh: 又罷未授職庶吉士保列一等之例，以示限制。

translations.literal: The rule allowing unassigned Hanlin bachelors to be recommended for first grade was also abolished, to show restraint.
translations.idiomatic: The practice of recommending unassigned Hanlin bachelors for first grade was also abolished as a further limit.

sentences.zh: 四十二年，命部、院保送一等人數，毋庸過泥上屆成例，遞行裁減，以防溢額。

translations.literal: In the forty-second year, departments and bureaus were ordered that first-grade recommendations need not rigidly follow the previous cycle's precedent and should be progressively reduced to prevent overflow.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-second year (1777), departments and bureaus were told not to treat the previous cycle's numbers as a rigid precedent and to reduce first-grade recommendations progressively to prevent quota inflation.

sentences.zh: 應將上兩次數目比較，酌中定制。

translations.literal: The numbers from the last two cycles should be compared and a moderate fixed rule adopted.
translations.idiomatic: The numbers from the last two cycles were to be compared and a balanced fixed quota adopted.

sentences.zh: 既無慮濫膺保薦，亦不至屈抑人才。

translations.literal: Thus there would be no worry of indiscriminate recommendation, nor of unjustly suppressing talent.
translations.idiomatic: This would guard against indiscriminate recommendations without unjustly suppressing able men.

sentences.zh: 五十年，定例保送一等人數，以不溢四十八年原額為準。

translations.literal: In the fiftieth year, the number recommended for first grade was fixed by rule, using the forty-eighth year's original quota as the ceiling.
translations.idiomatic: In the fiftieth year (1785), the number of first-grade recommendations was fixed by rule, with the forty-eighth year's original quota as the ceiling.

sentences.zh: 後世踵行，間有增損，無甚懸殊也。

translations.literal: Later ages followed in succession, with occasional increases or decreases, but no great divergence.
translations.idiomatic: Later reigns followed the same practice, with occasional adjustments but no major departure.

sentences.zh: 向例部、院司官由吏部、都察院考覈，雍正四年，命內閣大學士同閱。

translations.literal: By former rule, department and bureau clerks were examined by the Ministry of Personnel and the Censorate; in the fourth year of Yongzheng, Grand Secretaries of the Grand Council were ordered to review jointly.
translations.idiomatic: By former practice, department and bureau clerks were examined by the Ministry of Personnel and the Censorate. In the fourth year of Yongzheng (1726), Grand Secretaries were ordered to review them jointly.

sentences.zh: 乾隆九年，帝慮部、院堂官有瞻徇情面濫列一等者，敕大學士驗看，慎重甄別，不稱一等者裁去。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Qianlong, the emperor feared that department and bureau heads showed partiality and listed unworthy men in the first grade; he ordered grand ministers to inspect, carefully screen, and cut those unfit for first grade.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Qianlong (1744), fearing that department and bureau heads were showing favoritism and listing unworthy men as first grade, the emperor ordered grand ministers to inspect the lists, screen candidates carefully, and remove those unfit for first grade.

sentences.zh: 十一年諭曰：「前命大學士分別去留，亦權宜辦理之道。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year an edict said: The earlier order for grand ministers to decide retention and removal was also an expedient measure.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year (1746) an edict stated: "The earlier order for grand ministers to decide who should stay or go was only an expedient measure.

sentences.zh: 察覈司員，惟堂官最為親切。

translations.literal: In examining clerks, only the department head is most intimate with them.
translations.idiomatic: In examining clerks, no one is closer to the facts than the department head.

sentences.zh: 要在平日留心體察，臨時舉措公平。

translations.literal: The key is to observe attentively in daily affairs and act fairly at the time of evaluation.
translations.idiomatic: What matters is attentive observation in daily work and fair decisions when evaluations are due.

sentences.zh: 如上次定一等者，三年中行走平常，當改為二、三等。

translations.literal: If one fixed in the first grade last time performed only ordinarily over three years, he should be changed to the second or third grade.
translations.idiomatic: If someone rated first grade last time performed only ordinarily over the next three years, he should be moved to the second or third grade.

sentences.zh: 上次原列二、三等者，三年中知所奮勉，即改為一等。

translations.literal: If one formerly listed in the second or third grade strove diligently over three years, he should at once be changed to the first grade.
translations.idiomatic: If someone previously rated second or third grade showed real improvement over three years, he should be promoted to first grade.

sentences.zh: 庶察典肅而人知勸懲。

translations.literal: Thus the inspection system would be strict and people would know encouragement and punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Only then will the inspection system be rigorous and officials understand what reward and punishment mean."

sentences.zh: 」厥後考察權責，悉屬吏部，驗看特奉行故事而已。

translations.literal: Thereafter the authority and responsibility of examination all belonged to the Ministry of Personnel; inspection by grand ministers was only a formality carried on by precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter examination authority rested entirely with the Ministry of Personnel, while review by grand ministers became a mere formality observed by precedent.

sentences.zh: 大臣循例自陳求斥罷，候旨照舊供職，國初以來行之。

translations.literal: Grand ministers by routine submitted self-criticism asking to be dismissed, awaited the decree, and continued in office as before; this had been practiced since the founding of the dynasty.
translations.idiomatic: Grand ministers routinely submitted self-criticism asking to be dismissed, then awaited the imperial reply and continued in office as before—a practice followed since the founding of the dynasty.

sentences.zh: 乾隆八年，曾諭大臣自陳罷斥者舉賢自代。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Qianlong, ministers who submitted self-criticism asking dismissal were once ordered to recommend worthy men to replace themselves.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Qianlong (1743), ministers who submitted self-criticism asking to be dismissed were once ordered to recommend worthy successors.

sentences.zh: 嗣以所舉不得其人，或樹黨營私，行不久即罷。

translations.literal: Later, because those recommended were not the right men, or formed factions for private gain, the practice was soon abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The practice was soon abandoned because recommended successors were often unsuitable or were promoted to build factions for private gain.

sentences.zh: 十七年，帝以「內、外大臣親自簡擢，隨時黜陟，奚待三年？

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year the emperor said: Inner and outer grand ministers personally select and promote; they dismiss and advance at any time—why wait three years?
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year (1752) the emperor said: "Inner and outer grand ministers personally select and promote officials and dismiss or advance them at any time—why wait three years?

sentences.zh: 自陳繁文，相率為偽，甚無謂也」。

translations.literal: Self-criticism is verbose paperwork; all follow one another in pretense—it is quite pointless.
translations.idiomatic: These self-criticism memorials are empty formalities; everyone follows the same pretense. The whole thing is pointless."

sentences.zh: 詔罷其例。

translations.literal: An edict abolished the practice.
translations.idiomatic: An edict abolished the practice.

sentences.zh: 先是京堂官無甄敘例，乾隆十五年，帝以三品以上堂官，具本自陳，部、院司員，皆令引見，而四、五品京堂不在自陳之列，亦無引見之例，吏部、都察院考語無實，龍鍾庸劣者得姑容，才具優長者無由見。

translations.literal: Earlier capital officials had no rule for merit deliberation. In the fifteenth year of Qianlong, the emperor noted that third rank and above capital officials submitted memorial self-criticism and department and bureau clerks were all presented for audience, but fourth- and fifth-rank capital officials were not in the self-criticism list and had no audience rule; Ministry of Personnel and Censorate evaluations were unreal; doddering and mediocre men were tolerated, while men of superior talent had no way to be seen.
translations.idiomatic: Capital officials had previously had no rule for merit deliberation. In the fifteenth year of Qianlong (1750), the emperor observed that third-rank capital officials and above submitted formal self-criticism and that department and bureau clerks were presented for audience, while fourth- and fifth-rank capital officials were excluded from both procedures. Ministry and Censorate evaluations were hollow: doddering mediocrities were tolerated, while able men had no way to be recognized.

sentences.zh: 特派王、大臣分別等第，奏聞引見。

translations.literal: Princes and grand ministers were specially dispatched to assign grades separately, memorialized for audience.
translations.idiomatic: Princes and grand ministers were specially assigned to grade them separately and present the results in memorial for imperial audience.

sentences.zh: 十八年，敕吏部開列三品京堂事實，親為裁奪。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, the Ministry of Personnel was ordered to list facts on third-rank capital officials for the emperor personally to decide.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year (1753), the Ministry of Personnel was ordered to submit factual reports on third-rank capital officials for the emperor to decide personally.

sentences.zh: 四十八年，以三品京堂不便派大臣驗看，令吏部帶額引見。

translations.literal: In the forty-eighth year, because it was inconvenient to send grand ministers to inspect third-rank capital officials, the Ministry of Personnel was ordered to present them for audience within quota.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-eighth year (1783), because it was awkward to send grand ministers to inspect third-rank capital officials, the Ministry of Personnel was ordered to present them for audience within the fixed quota.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶十二年，以三、四品京堂，向來京察但有降黜無甄敘，既與內、外大臣辦理兩歧，並不得與部、院司員同邀加級。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Jiaqing, because third- and fourth-rank capital officials in the capital inspection had only demotion and no merit deliberation—diverging from inner and outer grand ministers in procedure and unable to receive rank advancement like department and bureau clerks—
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year of Jiaqing (1807), because third- and fourth-rank capital officials in the capital inspection could only be demoted and never receive merit deliberation—unlike inner and outer grand ministers in procedure and unlike department and bureau clerks in rank advancement—

sentences.zh: 於是予太常少卿色克精額等議敘，而予陳鍾琛等休致。

translations.literal: thereupon Vice Minister of Rites Sekesengge and others received merit deliberation, while Chen Zhongchen and others were retired.
translations.idiomatic: the court granted merit deliberation to Vice Minister of Rites Sekesengge and others, while Chen Zhongchen and others were retired.

sentences.zh: 自後三品以下京堂始有甄敘之例矣。

translations.literal: From then on capital officials below third rank first had a rule for merit deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: From then on, capital officials below third rank finally had a rule for merit deliberation.

sentences.zh: 年老休致，例有明文。

translations.literal: Retirement on account of age had clear written rules.
translations.idiomatic: Retirement on grounds of age was clearly regulated.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十二年，定部、院屬官五十五歲以上，堂官詳加甄別。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year of Qianlong, department and bureau subordinates aged fifty-five and above were ordered to be carefully screened by their department heads.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year of Qianlong (1757), department and bureau subordinates aged fifty-five and above were to be carefully screened by their department heads.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，改定京察二、三等留任各官，六十五歲以上引見。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year, it was revised that capital-inspection second- and third-grade officials retained in post who were sixty-five and above should be presented for audience.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-third year (1768), officials retained in post after second- or third-grade capital inspection who were sixty-five or older were required to be presented for audience.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶三年，命京察二、三等官引見，以年逾七十為限。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jiaqing, capital-inspection second- and third-grade officials were ordered presented for audience, with the limit set at over seventy years of age.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Jiaqing (1798), second- and third-grade capital inspection officials were to be presented for audience only if over seventy.

sentences.zh: 尋復舊例。

translations.literal: Soon the former rule was restored.
translations.idiomatic: The former rule was soon restored.

sentences.zh: 六法處分綦嚴，長官往往博寬大之名，每屆京察，祗黜退數人，虛應故事，餘概優容，而被劾者又不免屈抑。

translations.literal: Disposition under the six categories was extremely strict, yet superiors often sought a reputation for leniency; each capital inspection dismissed only a few men, empty compliance with form, the rest broadly indulged, while those impeached were not spared wrongful suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Penalties under the six categories were strict on paper, yet superiors often cultivated a reputation for leniency. Each capital inspection dismissed only a handful of officials in perfunctory compliance, indulged nearly everyone else, and still allowed those impeached to be unfairly suppressed.

sentences.zh: 雍正中，汪景祺、查嗣庭輩論列時政，以部員壅滯為言，有「十年不調、白首為郎」等語。

translations.literal: In the Yongzheng period, Wang Jingqi, Zha Siting, and others discussed current affairs, speaking of congestion among ministry staff, with phrases such as ten years without transfer, white-haired yet still a gentleman-attendant.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yongzheng reign, Wang Jingqi, Zha Siting, and others discussed current affairs and complained of congestion in the ministries, using phrases such as "ten years without transfer, white-haired yet still a gentleman-attendant."

sentences.zh: 帝責以怨望誹謗，而事實不得謂誣。

translations.literal: The emperor reproached them for resentful slander, yet the facts could not be called false.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor condemned them for resentful slander, yet the facts could hardly be called false.

sentences.zh: 蓋部員冗濫，康、雍時已然矣。

translations.literal: For ministry staff were redundant and excessive—this was already so in the Kangxi and Yongzheng periods.
translations.idiomatic: Ministry staffs were already bloated in the Kangxi and Yongzheng periods.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三年，鴻臚少卿查斯海疏言：「京官被劾，不無以嫌隙入吏議者。

translations.literal: In the third year of Qianlong, Vice Minister of Rites Zha Sihai memorialized: Capital officials impeached are not without cases where personal grudges enter the personnel deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Qianlong (1738), Vice Minister of Rites Zha Sihai memorialized: "When capital officials are impeached, personal grudges sometimes shape the personnel review.

sentences.zh: 京察六法官，應援大計例送部引見。

translations.literal: Capital-inspection officials under the six categories should follow the grand-assessment precedent and be sent to the ministry for audience.
translations.idiomatic: Officials penalized under the six capital-inspection categories should follow the grand-assessment precedent and be sent to the ministry for audience.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 乾隆末，士夫習為諂諛，堂官拔識司員，率以逢迎巧捷為曉事，察典懈弛。

translations.literal: At the end of Qianlong, scholars and officials were accustomed to flattery; department heads selecting clerks mostly took ingratiating cleverness as understanding affairs, and the inspection system grew lax.
translations.idiomatic: By the end of the Qianlong reign, officials had grown accustomed to flattery. Department heads mostly favored clerks who were ingratiating and quick-witted, treating such traits as practical competence, and the inspection system grew lax.

sentences.zh: 仁宗初，銳意求治，頗思以崇實黜華，獎勵氣節，風示天下。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Renzong's reign, he was keen to seek good governance and wished to elevate substance over show, reward moral integrity, and set an example for the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Jiaqing reign, the emperor was determined to improve governance and sought to elevate substance over display, reward moral integrity, and set an example for the empire.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶五年，詔部、院堂官慎重選舉，猷守兼優者膺首薦，餘寧取資格較久、謹愿樸實之員，其少年浮薄、才華髮越者，應令深其經練，下屆保列。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Jiaqing, department and bureau heads were ordered to choose carefully in evaluation: those excellent in both planning and integrity should receive first recommendation; for the rest, prefer those of longer seniority who were cautious, willing, and plain; youthful flighty men and those of overflowing talent should deepen their experience and be recommended in the next cycle.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Jiaqing (1800), department and bureau heads were ordered to evaluate carefully: those outstanding in both policy and integrity should receive first recommendation; otherwise prefer officers of longer seniority who were cautious and solid; youthful flighty men and those of flashy talent should gain more experience and wait for the next cycle.

sentences.zh: 尚書、侍郎各備冊密識賢否，公議同覽。

translations.literal: Ministers and vice ministers each kept registers privately noting merit or fault, for joint review in public deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers and vice ministers were each to keep private registers noting who was capable or not, to be reviewed jointly in consultation.

sentences.zh: 十一年，大學士、尚書等議奏京察事宜：「捐納人員，限以年資，軍機處司員能兼部務者，方列上考，不許濫保充數。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, grand ministers and ministers deliberated and memorialized on capital inspection: Purchased-office men were limited by seniority; Grand Council clerks who could handle ministry affairs might receive top rating; indiscriminate recommendation to fill quotas was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year (1806), grand ministers and ministers memorialized on capital inspection: "Purchased-office holders were to be limited by seniority; Grand Council clerks could receive top ratings only if they could handle ministry work; indiscriminate recommendations to fill quotas were forbidden.

sentences.zh: 」報可。

translations.literal: The memorial was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The memorial was approved.

sentences.zh: 道光四年，候際清贖罪舞弊一案，刑部司員恩德等朋謀撞騙堂官，以謬登薦牘，保列一等，下部議處。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Daoguang, in the case of Hou Jiqing's ransomed-guilt fraud, Ministry of Justice clerks Ende and others conspired to deceive their department head and were falsely entered on recommendation documents as first grade; the matter was sent down for deliberation and disposition.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Daoguang (1824), in the Hou Jiqing ransom-fraud case, Ministry of Justice clerks Ende and others conspired to deceive their department head and were falsely listed as first grade on recommendation documents; the case was sent down for disciplinary deliberation.

sentences.zh: 諭嗣後京察有冒濫徇私者連坐。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that hereafter in the capital inspection, those who recklessly overflowed quotas or showed private favor would be punished by joint liability.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ruled that thereafter anyone who abused capital inspection quotas or showed favoritism would be punished together with subordinates.

sentences.zh: 七年，給事中吳傑奏：「大計、軍政，皆有舉有劾。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, Supervising Secretary Wu Jie memorialized: The grand assessment and military evaluation both have recommendation and impeachment.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year (1827), Supervising Secretary Wu Jie memorialized: "The grand assessment and military evaluations both combine commendation and impeachment.

sentences.zh: 近年六部辦理京察，除保舉一等外，不問賢否，概列二等。

translations.literal: In recent years the six ministries handled the capital inspection: apart from recommending first grade, without regard to merit all were generally listed second grade.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years the six ministries, apart from first-grade recommendations, listed nearly everyone second grade regardless of merit.

sentences.zh: 間有三等數人，仍予留任。

translations.literal: Occasionally a few third-grade men were still retained in post.
translations.idiomatic: A few third-grade ratings appeared occasionally, yet even those officers were usually retained.

sentences.zh: 六法不施，有勸無懲。

translations.literal: The six categories were not applied; there was encouragement without punishment.
translations.idiomatic: The six penalty categories were not enforced; there was reward without punishment.

sentences.zh: 應申明舊章，舉劾並用。

translations.literal: The old regulations should be declared and recommendation and impeachment used together.
translations.idiomatic: The old regulations should be reaffirmed so commendation and impeachment are used together.

sentences.zh: 」帝韙其言，降諭飭行。

translations.literal: The emperor approved his words and issued an edict ordering enforcement.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor approved and issued an edict ordering enforcement.

sentences.zh: 十五年，令於京察外隨時糾參，以為補救。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, impeachment outside the capital inspection was ordered at any time as a remedy.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year (1835), officials were allowed to impeach wrongdoers at any time outside the capital inspection cycle as a corrective measure.

sentences.zh: 咸豐十年，刑部堂官濫保不諳例案之員，朝廷務循寬大，輒以相習成風，不獨刑部為然，多為原宥。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Xianfeng, Ministry of Justice heads indiscriminately recommended men ignorant of precedent cases; the court sought leniency, and this became habitual—not only in the Ministry of Justice; most were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year of Xianfeng (1860), Ministry of Justice heads indiscriminately recommended officials ignorant of case precedents. The court preferred leniency, and the practice spread beyond the Ministry of Justice; most offenders were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 僅予大學士桂良等鐫級留任，出考堂官罰俸而已。

translations.literal: Only Grand Secretary Gui Liang and others had rank inscription and retention in post; the examining department heads were merely fined salary.
translations.idiomatic: Only Grand Secretary Gui Liang and others received a one-step demotion while remaining in post; the department heads who conducted the evaluation were merely fined.

sentences.zh: 穆宗即位，大難未平，厲精澄敘。

translations.literal: When Muzong took the throne, great calamity was not yet settled; he strove to clarify and screen personnel.
translations.idiomatic: When the Tongzhi Emperor took the throne, with great calamity still unresolved, he strove to clarify personnel evaluation.

sentences.zh: 同治五年，詔部、院堂官謹遵嘉慶五年備冊密識賢否、公議同覽之諭，並常川進署，與司員講求公事，藉覘其屬賢否。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Tongzhi, department and bureau heads were ordered strictly to follow the Jiaqing fifth-year edict on keeping registers privately noting merit, joint review, regularly entering office, discussing public business with clerks, and thereby observing their subordinates' merit.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Tongzhi (1866), department and bureau heads were ordered to follow the Jiaqing fifth-year edict on private registers and joint review, to attend office regularly, discuss official business with clerks, and thereby observe their subordinates' merit.

sentences.zh: 八年，又諭京察不得有舉無劾，冀湔滌舊習，一新庶政。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, it was again ordered that the capital inspection must not have recommendation without impeachment, hoping to wash away old habits and renew common governance.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year (1869), the court again ordered that capital inspection must include impeachment as well as commendation, hoping to wash away old habits and renew governance.

sentences.zh: 然積重之勢，不能復返。

translations.literal: Yet the weight of accumulated habit could not be reversed.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the weight of long-standing habit could not be reversed.

sentences.zh: 光緒七年，禮部侍郎寶廷疏陳京察積弊，言之痛切，謂：「瞻徇情面之弊，不專在部、院堂官，當責樞臣考察，必公必嚴。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Guangxu, Vice Minister of Rites Baoting memorialized on accumulated abuses in the capital inspection, speaking with painful force: The abuse of showing partiality lies not only with department and bureau heads; the Grand Council should be charged with examination, which must be fair and strict.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Guangxu (1881), Vice Minister of Rites Baoting memorialized on the accumulated abuses of capital inspection, speaking with painful force: "The abuse of favoritism lies not only with department and bureau heads; the Grand Council should be charged with examination, and that examination must be fair and strict.

sentences.zh: 樞臣果精白乃心，破除情面，不特能考察部、院司員之賢否，並能考察內、外大臣之賢否。

translations.literal: If the Grand Council were truly pure in heart and broke through personal ties, they could not only examine the merit of department and bureau clerks but also examine the merit of inner and outer grand ministers.
translations.idiomatic: If the Grand Council were truly pure in heart and broke through personal ties, they could examine not only department and bureau clerks but also inner and outer grand ministers.

sentences.zh: 而考察樞臣功過，在聖明獨斷。

translations.literal: Yet examining the merits and faults of the Grand Council rested in the sage emperor's sole decision.
translations.idiomatic: Examining the Grand Council itself, however, rested in the emperor's sole judgment.

sentences.zh: 若朝廷先以京察為故事具文，何責乎樞臣，更何責乎部、院堂官！

translations.literal: If the court first treated the capital inspection as empty precedent, how could the Grand Council be blamed, much less department and bureau heads!
translations.idiomatic: If the court itself treated capital inspection as empty precedent, how could one blame the Grand Council, much less department and bureau heads!

sentences.zh: 」論雖切中而難實行，徒託空言而已。

translations.literal: The argument, though penetrating, was hard to put into practice and remained empty words.
translations.idiomatic: " His argument, though penetrating, was hard to put into practice and remained empty words.

sentences.zh: 宣統二年，吏部設立憲政籌備處，改考功司為考績科，主文職功過應行變通事宜。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xuantong, the Ministry of Personnel established the Constitutional Preparation Office, changed the Department of Merit Evaluation to the Performance Evaluation Section, and oversaw matters requiring adjustment in civil officials' merits and faults.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xuantong (1910), the Ministry of Personnel established a Constitutional Preparation Office, renamed the Merit Evaluation Department the Performance Evaluation Section, and took charge of reforms needed in civil performance evaluation.

sentences.zh: 其時浮議紛紜，新舊雜糅，吏部等於贅疣矣。

translations.literal: At that time floating opinions were numerous, old and new mixed together, and the Ministry of Personnel was like a superfluous growth.
translations.idiomatic: By then debate was rampant, old and new practices were tangled together, and the Ministry of Personnel had become little more than a vestigial organ.

sentences.zh: 大計始順治二年，御史張濩疏請有司殿最，宜以守己端潔、實心愛民為上考。

translations.literal: The grand assessment began in the second year of Shunzhi, when Censor Zhang Huo memorialized that local administrators' ranking should take integrity in self-conduct and sincere love of the people as top rating.
translations.idiomatic: The grand assessment began in the second year of Shunzhi (1645), when Censor Zhang Huo proposed that local administrators be ranked with integrity and sincere care for the people as the highest standard.

sentences.zh: 部覆如議。

translations.literal: The ministry replied approving the proposal.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry approved the proposal.

sentences.zh: 明年，定朝覲考察，頒五花冊，令督、撫以四格註考。

translations.literal: The next year, court-audience evaluation was fixed; five-colored registers were issued, ordering governors-general and governors to enter evaluations by the four criteria.
translations.idiomatic: The following year court-audience evaluation was codified. Five-colored registers were issued, and governors-general and governors were ordered to record evaluations under the four criteria.

sentences.zh: 故事，計參外，台、省例有拾遺。

translations.literal: By precedent, apart from assessment impeachment, the Censorate routinely had supplementary impeachment.
translations.idiomatic: By precedent, apart from formal assessment impeachment, the Censorate also conducted supplementary impeachments.

sentences.zh: 是歲計群吏，止據撫、按所揭為黜陟。

translations.literal: That year in assessing all officials, only the reports of governors and provincial censors were used for dismissal and promotion.
translations.idiomatic: That year, in assessing officials, dismissals and promotions relied solely on reports from governors and provincial censors.

sentences.zh: 台、省擬循故事，內大臣不喜。

translations.literal: The Censorate proposed to follow precedent; inner grand ministers were displeased.
translations.idiomatic: The Censorate proposed following precedent, but inner grand ministers were displeased.

sentences.zh: 大學士陳名夏力主之，給事中魏象樞亦以為請。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Chen Mingxia strongly supported it; Supervising Secretary Wei Xiangshu also requested it.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Chen Mingxia strongly supported the Censorate; Supervising Secretary Wei Xiangshu also petitioned for it.

sentences.zh: 得旨，糾拾官照大計處分挾私妄糾者論。

translations.literal: An imperial rescript was received: supplementary impeachment officials were to be punished under grand-assessment rules if they impeached from private motives.
translations.idiomatic: The throne ruled that supplementary impeachment officials who acted from private motives would be punished under grand-assessment rules.

sentences.zh: 自後台、省意存瞻顧，糾拾者鮮。

translations.literal: Thereafter the Censorate minded favoritism and supplementary impeachers were few.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter the Censorate minded favoritism, and supplementary impeachments became rare.

sentences.zh: 已，罷不行，而督、撫權乃日重矣。

translations.literal: Soon it was abolished and not carried out, while the power of governors-general and governors grew daily heavier.
translations.idiomatic: The practice was soon abolished, and the power of governors-general and governors grew steadily heavier.

sentences.zh: 四年，定大計三年一舉，計處官不許還職。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, the grand assessment was fixed at once every three years; officials disposed of in the assessment were not allowed to return to office.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, the grand assessment was fixed at once every three years, and officials penalized in the assessment were not allowed to return to office.

sentences.zh: 諭朝覲官曰：「貪酷重懲，闒茸罔貰。

translations.literal: Officials attending court audience were instructed: The greedy and cruel shall be heavily punished; the incompetent shall not be pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: Officials attending court audience were instructed: "The greedy and cruel shall be heavily punished; the incompetent shall not be pardoned.

sentences.zh: 爾等姑許留任，當思祓濯前愆，勉圖後效。

translations.literal: You are for the present allowed to remain in post; you should think to wash away former faults and strive for later achievement.
translations.idiomatic: For the present you are allowed to remain in post; wash away your former faults and strive for better results hereafter.

sentences.zh: 」嗣是每屆入覲之年，必嚴切誡飭以為常。

translations.literal: Thereafter, each year of court audience brought stern admonition as routine.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereafter, each court-audience year brought stern admonitions as routine.

sentences.zh: 舊例朝覲計典，籓、臬、府、州、縣正官皆入覲。

translations.literal: By old rule in the court-audience assessment, provincial commissioners, circuit intendants, prefects, subprefects, and magistrates in regular posts all attended court.
translations.idiomatic: Under the old court-audience assessment rule, provincial commissioners, circuit intendants, prefects, subprefects, and magistrates all attended court in person.

sentences.zh: 順治九年，止令籓、臬各一員、各府佐一員代覲。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Shunzhi, only one provincial commissioner and one circuit intendant each, and one prefectural assistant each, were ordered to attend in proxy.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Shunzhi (1652), only one provincial commissioner and one circuit intendant per province, and one prefectural assistant per prefecture, were sent to attend in proxy.

sentences.zh: 十八年，給事中雷一龍疏言；

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, Supervising Secretary Lei Yilong memorialized:
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year (1661), Supervising Secretary Lei Yilong memorialized:

sentences.zh: 「三年大計，勿得遺大吏而摘微員，懲去位而寬現在。

translations.literal: In the triennial grand assessment, do not overlook great officials while picking out minor clerks, or punish those already removed while indulging those now in office.
translations.idiomatic: "In the triennial grand assessment, do not overlook senior officials while picking on minor clerks, or punish those already out of office while indulging those still in post.

sentences.zh: 請令籓、臬赴部，面同指實，按冊詳察。

translations.literal: Request that provincial commissioners and circuit intendants come to the ministry, face examination together with pointing out facts, and be scrutinized in detail according to the registers.
translations.idiomatic: Let provincial commissioners and circuit intendants come to the ministry, examine the facts face to face, and scrutinize the registers in detail.

sentences.zh: 」下部議行。

translations.literal: The memorial was sent down to the ministries for deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: " The memorial was sent down to the ministries for deliberation and implementation.

sentences.zh: 康熙元年，停籓、臬入覲，以參政、副使等官代。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kangxi, provincial commissioners and circuit intendants ceased court attendance; administrative commissioners and vice commissioners attended in their place.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Kangxi, provincial commissioners and circuit intendants ceased attending court; administrative commissioners and vice commissioners attended in their place.

sentences.zh: 十二年，復令籓、臬入覲。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, provincial commissioners and circuit intendants were again ordered to attend court.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, provincial commissioners and circuit intendants were again ordered to attend court.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，以朝覲藉端苛派，奸弊滋生，籓、臬、府佐入覲例悉罷。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, because court audience was used as a pretext for harsh levies and corruption flourished, the rules for provincial commissioners, circuit intendants, and prefectural assistants to attend court were all abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year (1686), because court audience was used as a pretext for harsh levies and corruption flourished, the rules requiring provincial commissioners, circuit intendants, and prefectural assistants to attend court were abolished.

sentences.zh: 官吏賢否去留，憑督、撫文冊，布、按二司冊籍悉停止。

translations.literal: Whether officials were worthy, retained, or removed depended on the written registers of governors-general and governors; the registers of the provincial administration and surveillance commissioners were all stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Whether officials stayed or went depended on the written registers of governors-general and governors; the parallel registers of the provincial administration and surveillance commissioners were discontinued.

sentences.zh: 國初大計與考滿並行，康熙元年，罷大計，止行考滿。

translations.literal: At the founding of the dynasty the grand assessment and triennial completion ran in parallel; in the first year of Kangxi the grand assessment was abolished and only triennial completion was used.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the dynasty the grand assessment and triennial completion ran in parallel. In the first year of Kangxi the grand assessment was abolished and only triennial completion remained.

sentences.zh: 司、道歷腹俸二年、邊俸一年半，有司歷邊俸二年、腹俸三年，錢糧全完者許考滿。

translations.literal: Circuit and intendants served two years of interior salary and one and a half years of frontier salary; local administrators served two years of frontier salary and three years of interior salary; those who completed grain and tax accounts might undergo triennial completion.
translations.idiomatic: Circuit intendants and intendants served two years on interior salary and one and a half on frontier salary; local administrators served two years on frontier salary and three on interior salary. Those who completed tax accounts in full were eligible for triennial completion.

sentences.zh: 分別地方荒殘、沖疲、充實、簡易四者開註，以政績多寡酌定等第。

translations.literal: Places were distinguished as devastated, heavily burdened, prosperous, or simple, entered accordingly, and grades were set by the amount of administrative achievement.
translations.idiomatic: Localities were classified as devastated, heavily burdened, prosperous, or simple, and grades were set according to administrative achievement under each condition.

sentences.zh: 四年，考滿停，復行大計，為永制。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, triennial completion was stopped and the grand assessment was restored as the permanent rule.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, triennial completion was stopped and the grand assessment was restored as the permanent rule.

sentences.zh: 大計舉劾註考，例由州、縣正官申送本府、道考覈；

translations.literal: Grand-assessment recommendation, impeachment, and evaluation records were by rule submitted by magistrates and subprefects to prefectures and circuits for examination;
translations.idiomatic: Grand-assessment recommendations, impeachments, and evaluation records were by rule submitted by magistrates and subprefects to prefectures and circuits for examination;

sentences.zh: 教官由學道，鹽政官由該正官考覈；

translations.literal: educational officials by the educational circuit; salt administrators by their supervising regular official;
translations.idiomatic: educational officials by the educational circuit, and salt administrators by their supervising regular official;

sentences.zh: 轉呈布、按覆考，督、撫覈定，咨達部、院。

translations.literal: then forwarded to provincial administration and surveillance commissioners for re-examination, fixed by governors-general and governors, and reported to ministries and bureaus.
translations.idiomatic: then forwarded to provincial administration and surveillance commissioners for re-examination, finalized by governors-general and governors, and reported to the ministries and bureaus.

sentences.zh: 河官兼有刑名、錢糧之責者，總河、督、撫各行考覈。

translations.literal: River officials who also bore criminal and fiscal duties were examined separately by the Director-General of Rivers and by governors-general and governors.
translations.idiomatic: River officials who also bore criminal and fiscal duties were examined separately by the Director-General of Rivers and by governors-general and governors.

sentences.zh: 專管河務者，總河自行考覈具題。

translations.literal: Those who managed river affairs exclusively were examined and memorialized by the Director-General of Rivers himself.
translations.idiomatic: Those who managed river affairs exclusively were examined and memorialized by the Director-General of Rivers himself.

sentences.zh: 康熙二十三年，以籓、臬與督、撫親近，停其卓異。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year of Kangxi, because provincial commissioners and circuit intendants were close to governors-general and governors, their outstanding ratings were stopped.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year of Kangxi (1684), because provincial commissioners and circuit intendants were close to governors-general and governors, they were no longer eligible for outstanding ratings.

sentences.zh: 凡卓異官紀錄即升，不次擢用。

translations.literal: All outstanding officials were recorded and promoted immediately, with extraordinary appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Outstanding officials were recorded for merit and promoted immediately, often out of regular seniority order.

sentences.zh: 歷朝最重其選，徇私濫保者罪之。

translations.literal: Every dynasty valued this selection most highly; those who showed favoritism in indiscriminate recommendation were punished.
translations.idiomatic: Every dynasty valued this selection highly, and those who recommended unworthy men from favoritism were punished.

sentences.zh: 康熙初，御史張沖翼請申嚴卓異定額，以詳覈事迹，使名實相副為言。

translations.literal: Early in Kangxi, Censor Zhang Chongyi requested strict enforcement of outstanding quotas, detailed verification of facts, and that name and reality should match.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Kangxi, Censor Zhang Chongyi urged strict enforcement of outstanding quotas, detailed verification of facts, and a match between reputation and reality.

sentences.zh: 下部議。

translations.literal: The matter was sent down to the ministries for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: The matter was sent down to the ministries for deliberation.

sentences.zh: 六年，從御史田六善請，卓異官以清廉為本，司、道等官必註明不派節禮、索餽送，州、縣等官必註明不派雜差、重火耗、虧損行戶、強貸富民。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, following Censor Tian Liushan's request, outstanding officials were to take integrity as foundation; circuit and intendants must note no assignment of festival gifts or demands for presents; magistrates and subprefects must note no assignment of miscellaneous corvée, heavy melt fees, losses to merchant houses, or forced loans to wealthy households.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, following Censor Tian Liushan's request, outstanding officials were to be judged above all on integrity. Circuit intendants and intendants had to certify that they levied no festival gifts or demanded presents; magistrates and subprefects had to certify that they imposed no miscellaneous corvée, excessive melt fees, losses on merchant houses, or forced loans on wealthy households.

sentences.zh: 以清吏之有無，定督、撫之賢否。

translations.literal: By whether there were honest officials, the merit of governors-general and governors was determined.
translations.idiomatic: The merit of governors-general and governors was judged by whether their subordinates were honest officials.

sentences.zh: 其時廉吏輩出，靈壽令陸隴其等擢隸憲府，吏治蒸蒸，稱極盛焉。

translations.literal: At that time honest officials emerged in succession; Lingshou Magistrate Lu Longqi and others were promoted to judicial posts; administration flourished and was called at its height.
translations.idiomatic: At that time honest officials emerged in succession; Lingshou Magistrate Lu Longqi and others were promoted to judicial posts, and local administration flourished to a degree later called the high point of the age.

sentences.zh: 四十四年，詔舉卓異，務期無加派，無濫刑，無盜案，無錢糧拖久、倉庫虧空，民生得所，地方日有起色。

translations.literal: In the forty-fourth year, outstanding recommendation was ordered, aiming for no extra levies, no abusive punishment, no theft cases, no long arrears in grain and tax or granary deficits, the people's livelihood settled, and the locality daily improving.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-fourth year, outstanding recommendations were ordered to aim for no extra levies, no abusive punishment, no theft cases, no long tax arrears or granary deficits, a settled livelihood for the people, and steady improvement in local conditions.

sentences.zh: 其他虛文，不必開載。

translations.literal: Other empty phrases need not be entered.
translations.idiomatic: Other empty phrases need not be entered.

sentences.zh: 乾隆八年，命督、撫以務農本計察覈屬員，論者謂以勸農為勸吏之要，深得治本，與漢詔同風。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Qianlong, governors-general and governors were ordered to examine subordinates with agriculture as the fundamental task; commentators said that taking encouragement of farming as the key to encouraging officials grasped the root of governance and matched the spirit of Han edicts.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Qianlong (1743), governors-general and governors were ordered to evaluate subordinates with agriculture as the fundamental task. Commentators said that making encouragement of farming the key to encouraging officials grasped the root of governance and matched the spirit of Han edicts.

sentences.zh: 先是雍正六年，定卓異薦舉失實處分，自行奏參者免。

translations.literal: Earlier, in the sixth year of Yongzheng, penalties were fixed for false outstanding recommendation; those who memorialized and impeached themselves were exempted.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, in the sixth year of Yongzheng (1728), penalties were fixed for false outstanding recommendations, though those who reported their own errors were exempted.

sentences.zh: 卓異官有貪酷不法，或錢糧、盜案未清，發覺者，原薦督、撫處分較司、道、府為輕。

translations.literal: If outstanding officials were found greedy, cruel, and lawless, or with grain and tax or theft cases unsettled, the recommending governor-general or governor was punished more lightly than circuit, intendants, or prefects.
translations.idiomatic: If an outstanding official was later found greedy, cruel, or lawless, or with tax or theft cases unsettled, the recommending governor-general or governor was punished more lightly than the circuit intendant, intendant, or prefect who had forwarded the recommendation.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十八年，改定卓異官犯贓，覈其年月在原薦上司離任前後，分別議處。

translations.literal: In the forty-eighth year of Qianlong, it was revised that when outstanding officials committed graft, the date relative to their recommender's departure was verified and disposition was made separately.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-eighth year of Qianlong (1783), it was revised that when an outstanding official was found guilty of graft, the date of the offense relative to his recommender's departure would determine how each official was punished.

sentences.zh: 臬司、道、府減督、撫一等，籓司照督、撫例，以道、府按例轉詳督、撫、籓司親為覈定也。

translations.literal: Surveillance commissioners, circuit intendants, and prefects had one grade reduced from governors-general and governors; administration commissioners followed governors-general and governors' rule, as circuit and prefects forwarded reports by rule for governors-general, governors, and administration commissioners to verify personally.
translations.idiomatic: Surveillance commissioners, circuit intendants, and prefects received one grade less punishment than governors-general and governors; administration commissioners were punished like governors-general and governors, since circuit intendants and prefects forwarded reports for them to verify personally.

sentences.zh: 五十年，帝以保薦卓異，向分正附，未明定限制，易開徼幸之漸。

translations.literal: In the fiftieth year, the emperor noted that outstanding recommendation had been divided into principal and supplementary without clear limits, easily opening a path to opportunism.
translations.idiomatic: In the fiftieth year, the emperor noted that outstanding recommendations had been divided into principal and supplementary lists without clear limits, easily opening the way to opportunism.

sentences.zh: 敕部詳覈各省大小、缺分多寡，酌中定制，裁去附薦名目。

translations.literal: The ministry was ordered to examine in detail each province's size and number of posts, set a moderate fixed rule, and cut the supplementary recommendation category.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry was ordered to examine each province's size and number of posts, set a balanced fixed quota, and abolish the supplementary recommendation category.

sentences.zh: 於是各省卓異官有定額，終清世無大變更也。

translations.literal: Thereupon each province had fixed outstanding quotas, with no great change through the Qing.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter each province had fixed outstanding quotas, which changed little for the rest of the dynasty.

sentences.zh: 八法處分，行之既久，長吏或視為具文，每將微員細故，填註塞責。

translations.literal: Disposition under the eight categories had been practiced long; superiors sometimes treated it as empty form, filling in minor clerks' trifling matters to meet obligation.
translations.idiomatic: The eight penalty categories had long been in force, yet superiors sometimes treated them as empty form, filling registers with minor clerks' trifling faults merely to meet obligation.

sentences.zh: 歷朝訓諭諄諄，力戒瞻徇，猶防冤抑。

translations.literal: Dynasties repeatedly admonished earnestly, strictly forbidding partiality, yet still guarding against wrongful suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Dynasty after dynasty issued earnest admonitions against favoritism, while still guarding against wrongful suppression.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，詔大計降級罰俸官，例不許卓異，果有居官廉幹因公詿誤者，淮與卓異。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng, grand-assessment officials demoted or fined salary were by rule not allowed outstanding rating; if truly honest and capable in office but mistaken through public duty, they might receive outstanding rating.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yongzheng, officials demoted or fined in the grand assessment were normally barred from outstanding ratings, but honest and capable men who had erred through public duty could still receive them.

sentences.zh: 又以卓異八法舉劾不過數十人，其不列舉劾之平等官，自知縣以上，令督、撫註考，報部察核。

translations.literal: Also, as outstanding and eight-category recommendation and impeachment involved only several tens of men, ordinary officials from magistrates upward not listed for recommendation or impeachment were ordered evaluated by governors-general and governors and reported to the ministry for review.
translations.idiomatic: Because outstanding ratings and eight-category recommendations and impeachments involved only a few dozen men, ordinary officials from magistrates upward who were neither commended nor impeached were to be evaluated by governors-general and governors and reported to the ministry.

sentences.zh: 四年，諭參劾人員或有冤抑及避重就輕等弊，除貪酷官無庸引見外，其不謹、浮躁、不及等被劾官，督、撫給咨送部引見。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, it was ordered that impeached persons might suffer wrongful suppression or the abuses of avoiding the serious and stressing the light; apart from greedy and cruel officials who need not be presented, impeached officials for carelessness, flightiness, or falling short were given credentials by governors-general and governors and sent to the ministry for audience.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, the court noted that impeached officials might suffer wrongful suppression or that superiors might avoid serious charges and stress minor ones. Apart from the greedy and cruel, who need not be presented, impeached officials for carelessness, flightiness, or incompetence were to be sent to the ministry for audience.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十四年，帝以八法參本內不謹、浮躁官，未將何事不謹、何事浮躁、一一聲敘，或有公事無誤而節目闊疏，才具有為而氣質粗率，上司以意見不洽，概登白簡，不無可惜。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year of Qianlong, the emperor noted that in eight-category impeachment memorials, careless and flighty officials did not have what was careless or flighty stated one by one; some had no error in public business but were broad in procedure, some had talent and capacity but rough temperament, and superiors, from incompatible views, generally entered them on the dismissal list—it was not without regret.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year of Qianlong (1759), the emperor noted that eight-category impeachment memorials often failed to state exactly what made an official careless or flighty. Some had committed no error in public business but were broad in procedure; others had talent but rough temperaments. Superiors, from personal incompatibility, often listed them for dismissal—a waste the emperor regretted.

sentences.zh: 其或敗檢逾閒，僅與避重就輕，均非整飭官方之意。

translations.literal: Some who had ruined conduct and overstepped bounds were merely given the lighter charge of avoiding the serious—none of this accorded with the intent to rectify official discipline.
translations.idiomatic: Some who had ruined conduct were merely charged with the lighter offense of avoiding serious impeachment—none of this served the intent to rectify official discipline.

sentences.zh: 命詳註實跡，不得籠統參劾。

translations.literal: They were ordered to enter detailed facts and not impeach in general terms.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were ordered to record detailed facts and not impeach in vague generalities.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶八年，定督、撫隨時參劾闒冗平庸等事，未列敘寶跡，被劾官情原赴部引見者，得援大計六法例。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Jiaqing, governors-general and governors were fixed to impeach at any time for incompetence, mediocrity, and the like; if facts were not listed and the impeached official wished to go to the ministry for audience, the grand-assessment six-category precedent could be invoked.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Jiaqing (1803), governors-general and governors were allowed to impeach at any time for incompetence or mediocrity. If facts were not fully stated and the impeached official wished to appeal at the ministry, the six-category grand-assessment precedent applied.

sentences.zh: 此則考覈不厭詳密，冀搜求遺才，輔計典之不及也。

translations.literal: Here examination did not tire of detail, hoping to search out overlooked talent and supplement what the assessment cycle could not reach.
translations.idiomatic: Here examination was deliberately detailed, hoping to uncover overlooked talent and supplement what the formal assessment cycle could not reach.

sentences.zh: 嘉、道以後，計典一循舊例，督、撫奉行故事，鮮克振刷。

translations.literal: After Jiaqing and Daoguang, the assessment cycle followed old precedent; governors-general and governors observed form, rarely able to revive it.
translations.idiomatic: After the Jiaqing and Daoguang reigns, the assessment cycle followed old precedent, and governors-general and governors observed form without reviving its substance.

sentences.zh: 道光八年，山東大計卓異，護撫賀長齡原註新城令容昺悃愊慈祥等語，詔以寬厚難膺上考，令各省薦舉體用兼備、熟明治理者。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Daoguang, in Shandong's grand assessment outstanding rating, Acting Governor He Changling had originally noted Xincheng Magistrate Rong Bing as sincere, kindly, and gentle; an edict said such broad kindness could not bear top rating and ordered each province to recommend men combining substance and function who were skilled in governance.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Daoguang (1828), in Shandong's grand assessment, Acting Governor He Changling had described Xincheng Magistrate Rong Bing as sincere, kindly, and gentle. An edict ruled that mere broad kindness could not earn a top rating and ordered provinces to recommend men who combined substance and practical ability and knew how to govern.

sentences.zh: 咸、同軍興，或地方甫收復，有待撫綏，或疆圉偪寇氛，亟籌保衛，敕各督、撫留心存記廉能之員，列上考，備擢用。

translations.literal: In the Xianfeng and Tongzhi military emergencies, some places had just been recovered and awaited pacification, or frontiers faced rebel atmosphere and urgently needed defense; each governor-general and governor was ordered to keep in mind and record honest and capable men, list them for top rating, and hold them ready for promotion.
translations.idiomatic: During the Xianfeng and Tongzhi military emergencies, some regions had only just been recovered and needed pacification, while frontiers faced rebel threats and urgently needed defense. Governors-general and governors were ordered to note honest and capable men, rate them highly, and hold them ready for promotion.

sentences.zh: 時督、撫權宜行事，用人不拘資格，隨時舉措，固不能以大計常例繩其後也。

translations.literal: At that time governors-general and governors acted expediently, employed men without regard to qualification, and took measures as circumstances required—they could not be bound afterward by the grand assessment's ordinary rules.
translations.idiomatic: At that time governors-general and governors acted expediently, employed men without regard to seniority, and took measures as circumstances required; they could hardly be bound afterward by the ordinary rules of the grand assessment.

sentences.zh: 光緒間，言者每條奏計典積弊，請飭疆臣認真考察。

translations.literal: During Guangxu, memorialists often listed accumulated abuses of the assessment cycle and requested frontier officials conduct examination earnestly.
translations.idiomatic: During the Guangxu reign, memorialists often listed the accumulated abuses of the assessment cycle and urged frontier officials to examine subordinates earnestly.

sentences.zh: 屢詔戒飭。

translations.literal: Edicts repeatedly admonished and ordered discipline.
translations.idiomatic: Edicts repeatedly admonished them to do so.

sentences.zh: 然人才既衰，吏治日壞，徒法終不能行。

translations.literal: Yet talent had declined and administration worsened daily; empty law in the end could not be enforced.
translations.idiomatic: Yet talent had declined, administration worsened daily, and the law in the end could not be enforced.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，詔各省設立課吏館，限半年具奏一次。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, each province was ordered to establish an official evaluation hall, memorializing once every half year.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year, each province was ordered to establish an official evaluation hall and submit memorials every six months.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，定考覈州、縣事實，分最優等、優等、平等、次等四級。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year, examination of magistrates' and subprefects' facts was fixed, divided into highest, superior, ordinary, and inferior four grades.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year, evaluation of magistrates and subprefects was fixed in four grades: highest, superior, ordinary, and inferior.

sentences.zh: 顧課吏祗憑一日文字，考覈僅據一年事實，責以公當，蓋亦難矣。

translations.literal: Yet official evaluation relied only on one day's writing, and examination only on one year's facts—to demand fairness was indeed difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Yet evaluation relied on a single day's written test, and examination on only one year's record—to demand fairness was indeed difficult.

sentences.zh: 宣統二年，憲政編查館疏請考覈州、縣，分別學堂、巡警、工藝、種植、命盜、詞訟、監押、錢漕，以為殿最。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xuantong, the Constitutional Compilation and Review Office memorialized to examine magistrates and subprefects separately on schools, police, crafts, planting, homicides and thefts, lawsuits, detention, and grain transport as criteria for ranking.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xuantong, the Constitutional Compilation Office proposed evaluating magistrates and subprefects separately on schools, police, crafts, planting, homicides and thefts, lawsuits, detention, and grain transport.

sentences.zh: 由主管衙門另訂考覈章程。

translations.literal: Each supervising office was to draw up separate examination regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Each supervising office was to draw up separate evaluation regulations.

sentences.zh: 名目繁多，表冊虛偽，徒飾耳目，於勸懲無當也。

translations.literal: Categories were numerous, tables and registers false, merely adorning the senses, of no use for encouragement and punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Categories multiplied, tables and registers were false, and the whole system merely adorned the record without serving reward or punishment.

sentences.zh: 至若舊例翰、詹大考，分別優劣，升調降革有差，為特別考績之法。

translations.literal: As for the old rule of the Hanlin and Imperial Academy great examinations, distinguishing superior and inferior with differences in promotion, transfer, demotion, and dismissal, this was a special performance-evaluation method.
translations.idiomatic: The old rule of the Hanlin and Imperial Academy great examinations, distinguishing superior and inferior with differences in promotion, transfer, demotion, and dismissal, was a special performance-evaluation method.

sentences.zh: 外省司、道，年終有密考。

translations.literal: Outer-province intendants and circuit intendants had confidential year-end examinations.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial intendants and circuit intendants underwent confidential year-end examinations.

sentences.zh: 州、縣一年期滿，教、佐六年俸滿，皆有甄別。

translations.literal: Magistrates and subprefects at one-year term completion, educational and assistant officials at six-year salary completion, all had screening.
translations.idiomatic: Magistrates and subprefects were screened at the end of their one-year terms; educational and assistant officials at the end of six years of service.

sentences.zh: 則又隨時考核之法，不屬於察、計二典者。

translations.literal: These were methods of examination at any time, not belonging to the two cycles of inspection and assessment.
translations.idiomatic: These were methods of evaluation at any time, outside the two cycles of capital inspection and grand assessment.

sentences.zh: 武之軍政，猶文之考察，兵部職方司掌之。

translations.literal: The military evaluation was like the civil examination; the Ministry of War's Department of Appointments administered it.
translations.idiomatic: Military evaluation corresponded to civil inspection and was administered by the Ministry of War's Department of Appointments.

sentences.zh: 內、外衛、所，分屬於武選司。

translations.literal: Inner and outer guards and posts were divided under the Department of Military Selection.
translations.idiomatic: Inner and outer guards and posts fell under the Department of Military Selection.

sentences.zh: 在京武職，由管旗及部、院覈奏；

translations.literal: Capital military officials were examined and memorialized by banner commanders and ministries and bureaus;
translations.idiomatic: Capital military officials were examined and memorialized by banner commanders and by ministries and bureaus;

sentences.zh: 各省由統兵大員註考。

translations.literal: each province by the commanding military officer entering evaluation.
translations.idiomatic: each province by the commanding military officer who recorded evaluations.

sentences.zh: 京營千總以上，外省綠營守備以上，各由長官考覈，分操守、才能、騎射、年歲四格。

translations.literal: Capital garrison battalion commanders and above, outer-province Green Standard garrison commanders and above, were each examined by superiors, divided into integrity, ability, horsemanship and archery, and age four criteria.
translations.idiomatic: Capital garrison battalion commanders and above, and provincial Green Standard garrison commanders and above, were examined by their superiors under four criteria: integrity, ability, horsemanship and archery, and age.

sentences.zh: 舉劾與文職同。

translations.literal: Recommendation and impeachment were the same as for civil officials.
translations.idiomatic: Recommendation and impeachment followed the same rules as for civil officials.

sentences.zh: 三品以上自陳，由部疏聞候旨。

translations.literal: Third rank and above submitted self-criticism; the ministry memorialized for report to await the imperial decree.
translations.idiomatic: Officers of third rank and above submitted self-criticism; the ministry memorialized and awaited the imperial decree.

sentences.zh: 八旗世爵，則校其藝進退之。

translations.literal: Hereditary banners ranks were advanced or reduced according to their skill.
translations.idiomatic: Hereditary banner ranks were advanced or reduced according to their martial skill.

sentences.zh: 綠營舉劾，每于軍政後一年半舉行，題升一二人入薦舉班升用，劾者照軍政處分。

translations.literal: Green Standard recommendation and impeachment were held every year and a half after military evaluation; one or two men were nominated for promotion into the recommendation class; impeached men were disposed of as in military evaluation.
translations.idiomatic: Green Standard recommendations and impeachments were held a year and a half after each military evaluation; one or two men were nominated for promotion, and impeached men were punished under military-evaluation rules.

sentences.zh: 此其大略也。

translations.literal: This was the general outline.
translations.idiomatic: Such was the general outline.

sentences.zh: 國初未立限制，順治九年，定六年一舉，是為軍政考覈之始。

translations.literal: At the founding no limit was set; in the ninth year of Shunzhi, once every six years was fixed—this was the beginning of military evaluation.
translations.idiomatic: At the founding no limit was set. In the ninth year of Shunzhi (1652), a six-year cycle was fixed—the beginning of military evaluation.

sentences.zh: 十一年，改定五年為期。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, the period was changed to five years.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, the cycle was shortened to five years.

sentences.zh: 十三年，從給事中張文光請，軍政卓異，照文官賜服旌勸，後改為加一級。
