translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, following Supervising Secretary Zhang Wenguang's request, military evaluation outstanding rating, like civil officials, received bestowed robes and encouragement, later changed to one rank advancement.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, at Supervising Secretary Zhang Wenguang's request, outstanding military ratings first received robes and commendation like civil officials, later changed to a one-step rank advancement.

sentences.zh: 康熙元年，停軍政，專行考滿。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kangxi, military evaluation was stopped and only triennial completion was used.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Kangxi, military evaluation was stopped and only triennial completion was used.

sentences.zh: 既而兵部疏請直省武職應依文官例，按年限由總督、提督會同舉劾。

translations.literal: Soon the Ministry of War memorialized that direct-province military posts should follow civil officials' rule, and by term governors-general and provincial military commanders should jointly recommend and impeach.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the Ministry of War memorialized that provincial military posts should follow civil rules, with governors-general and provincial military commanders jointly recommending and impeaching by term of service.

sentences.zh: 御史季振宜疏言：「武職考滿，營謀優等，剋扣軍饟，貽誤封疆。

translations.literal: Censor Ji Zhenyi memorialized: Military triennial completion involves scheming for superior grades, deducting military pay, and harming the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Ji Zhenyi memorialized: "Military triennial completion has become a matter of scheming for superior grades, deducting military pay, and harming the frontier.

sentences.zh: 請按歷俸功次升轉。

translations.literal: Request promotion and transfer according to salary history and merit order.
translations.idiomatic: Promotions should follow salary history and merit order.

sentences.zh: 」於是六年定舉行軍政事宜，京、外武職長官，註以四格，並詳列履行、軍功，分別去留，咨部。

translations.literal: Thereupon in the sixth year military evaluation matters were fixed; capital and outer military superiors were entered under four criteria, with service records and military merit listed in detail, retention and removal distinguished, and reported to the ministry.
translations.idiomatic: " In the sixth year military evaluation was codified. Capital and provincial military commanders were rated under four criteria, with service records and military merit listed in detail, retention and removal distinguished, and reported to the ministry.

sentences.zh: 必註明行止端方、弓馬嫻熟、管轄嚴肅、供職勤慎、不擾害地方等考語，方許薦舉。

translations.literal: Evaluation phrases such as upright conduct, skilled archery and horsemanship, strict jurisdiction, diligent service, and not harming the locality had to be entered before recommendation was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Recommendations required explicit evaluation phrases such as upright conduct, skilled archery and horsemanship, strict command, diligent service, and no harm to the locality.

sentences.zh: 必有八法等款實跡，始行糾參。

translations.literal: There had to be factual evidence under the eight categories and the like before impeachment was carried out.
translations.idiomatic: Impeachment required factual evidence under the eight penalty categories.

sentences.zh: 復令提督、總兵官自陳，提督由總督註考，總兵官由總督、提督註考。

translations.literal: Provincial military commanders and regional commanders were again ordered to submit self-criticism; provincial commanders were evaluated by governors-general, regional commanders by governors-general and provincial commanders.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial military commanders and regional commanders were again ordered to submit self-criticism. Provincial commanders were evaluated by governors-general; regional commanders by governors-general and provincial commanders.

sentences.zh: 無總督省分，巡撫註考。

translations.literal: In provinces without a governor-general, the governor evaluated them.
translations.idiomatic: In provinces without a governor-general, the governor conducted the evaluation.

sentences.zh: 嗣以滇省用兵，海內騷動，羽書倥傯，軍政曠不舉行者十年。

translations.literal: Later, because Yunnan was at war and the realm was disturbed, urgent dispatches were unceasing, and military evaluation was neglected and not held for ten years.
translations.idiomatic: Later, war in Yunnan disturbed the realm, urgent dispatches were unceasing, and military evaluation was neglected for ten years.

sentences.zh: 至二十一年，滇逆蕩平，從給事中碩穆科請，舉行軍政大典，各官事實履行，自康熙十一年軍政後開起。

translations.literal: By the twenty-first year the Yunnan rebels were pacified; following Supervising Secretary Shuomuke's request, the great military evaluation was held, with each officer's factual service record counted from after the eleventh year of Kangxi's military evaluation.
translations.idiomatic: By the twenty-first year the Yunnan rebels were pacified. At Supervising Secretary Shuomuke's request, the great military evaluation was held, with each officer's service record counted from after the eleventh year of Kangxi's military evaluation.

sentences.zh: 九門千總等由九門提督註考。

translations.literal: Battalion commanders of the Nine Gates and the like were evaluated by the Nine Gates commander.
translations.idiomatic: Battalion commanders of the Nine Gates and the like were evaluated by the Nine Gates commander.

sentences.zh: 候補總兵官亦令自陳。

translations.literal: Candidate regional commanders were also ordered to submit self-criticism.
translations.idiomatic: Candidate regional commanders were also ordered to submit self-criticism.

sentences.zh: 副將以下候缺者，照舊例考察。

translations.literal: Brigadiers and below awaiting vacancies were examined by the old rule.
translations.idiomatic: Brigadiers and below awaiting vacancies were examined under the old rule.

sentences.zh: 六十一年，命在京武職領侍衛內大臣，八旗都統，前鋒、護軍、步軍統領，副都統等，毋庸自陳。

translations.literal: In the sixty-first year, capital military officials including leading imperial bodyguard grand ministers, Eight Banner commanders-in-chief, vanguard, guard, and infantry commanders-in-chief, and deputy commanders-in-chief were ordered not to submit self-criticism.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixty-first year, capital military officials including leading imperial bodyguard grand ministers, Eight Banner commanders-in-chief, vanguard, guard, and infantry commanders-in-chief, and deputy commanders-in-chief were exempted from self-criticism.

sentences.zh: 考選軍政時，屬員註考，照外省舉劾例。

translations.literal: At military evaluation selection, subordinates were entered for evaluation following the outer-province recommendation and impeachment rule.
translations.idiomatic: During military evaluation, subordinates were evaluated following the provincial recommendation and impeachment rules.

sentences.zh: 各省駐防將軍、副都統等，照提、鎮例自陳。

translations.literal: Garrison generals and deputy commanders-in-chief in each province submitted self-criticism following provincial and regional commander precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison generals and deputy commanders-in-chief in each province submitted self-criticism following provincial and regional commander precedent.

sentences.zh: 屬員照京城例。

translations.literal: Subordinates followed the capital rule.
translations.idiomatic: Their subordinates followed the capital rule.

sentences.zh: 德州等處城守尉、協領，派大臣往考，會同察覈其屬，註考以聞。

translations.literal: Garrison commandants and assistant commanders at Dezhou and elsewhere had grand ministers dispatched to examine them, jointly screening their subordinates and reporting evaluations.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison commandants and assistant commanders at Dezhou and elsewhere were examined by dispatched grand ministers, who jointly screened their subordinates and reported the evaluations.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，命平等官守備以上，督、撫、提、鎮註考。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng, ordinary officials from garrison commanders upward were ordered evaluated by governors-general, governors, provincial commanders, and regional commanders.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yongzheng, ordinary officers from garrison commanders upward were evaluated by governors-general, governors, provincial commanders, and regional commanders.

sentences.zh: 其冬，詔曰：「初次考選軍政，有出兵效力、年老俸深、尚能坐理者，留任。

translations.literal: That winter an edict said: At the first military evaluation selection, those who had served in campaign, were old with deep salary seniority, and could still manage affairs were retained.
translations.idiomatic: That winter an edict said: "At the first military evaluation, those who had served in campaign, were old with long seniority, and could still manage affairs were to be retained.

sentences.zh: 不宜留任者，另奏加恩。

translations.literal: Those unfit to remain were separately memorialized for special favor.
translations.idiomatic: Those unfit to remain were separately memorialized for special favor.

sentences.zh: 或雖未效力行間，而供職年久者，亦留心驗看。

translations.literal: Or though they had not served in the field, if they had served long in office, they were also to be carefully examined.
translations.idiomatic: Even those who had not served in the field but had long service were to be carefully examined.

sentences.zh: 」此則垂念資勞，特頒寬典，非常例也。

translations.literal: This showed concern for seniority and labor and specially issued a lenient rule—not the ordinary precedent.
translations.idiomatic: " This showed concern for seniority and long service and specially issued a lenient rule—not the ordinary precedent.

sentences.zh: 二年，諭各省所保副、參、游擊，輪流引見，察其人材弓馬，督、撫、提、鎮以其操守訓練，分別等第密陳。

translations.literal: In the second year, each province's recommended brigadiers, colonels, and regimental commanders were ordered presented in turn to observe talent and archery and horsemanship; governors-general, governors, provincial commanders, and regional commanders were to grade them secretly by integrity and training.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, recommended brigadiers, colonels, and regimental commanders from each province were presented in turn to observe talent and martial skill; governors-general, governors, provincial commanders, and regional commanders secretly graded them by integrity and training.

sentences.zh: 六年，山西太原總兵官袁立松疏陳平垣營守備梁玉廉潔敏練，以年老入參劾。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Shanxi Taiyuan Regional Commander Yuan Lisong memorialized that Pingyuan Garrison Commander Liang Yu was honest, alert, and skilled, yet was impeached for age.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, Shanxi Taiyuan Regional Commander Yuan Lisong memorialized that Pingyuan Garrison Commander Liang Yu was honest, alert, and skilled, yet was impeached for age.

sentences.zh: 帝以諳練才不可多得，命酌量以游擊題補，尤殊恩也。

translations.literal: The emperor said seasoned talent was hard to obtain and ordered him considered for regimental commander appointment—a special grace.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said seasoned talent was hard to find and ordered him considered for appointment as regimental commander—a special grace.

sentences.zh: 是年定卓異官原任有貪酷不法，或升調他省，別犯贓罪，原舉長官，分別處分。

translations.literal: That year it was fixed that if outstanding officials in their original posts were greedy and lawless, or were transferred to another province and separately committed graft, the original recommending superior was punished separately.
translations.idiomatic: That year it was fixed that if an outstanding official proved greedy or lawless in his original post, or was transferred and later committed graft elsewhere, the original recommender would be punished separately.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二年，部議出兵效力人員，年老休致，令子弟一人入伍食糧，無子弟亦給守糧養贍。

translations.literal: In the second year of Qianlong, the ministry deliberated that campaign veterans who retired on age should have one son or brother enter the ranks for rations; if none, guard-ration support was given.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Qianlong, the ministry ruled that campaign veterans who retired on age should have one son or brother enter the ranks for rations, or receive guard-ration support if they had no suitable relative.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The proposal was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 時直省保題員弁，類以明白勤敏、才堪辦事列上選。

translations.literal: At that time direct-province recommended officers were mostly listed for top selection as clear, diligent, alert, and capable of handling affairs.
translations.idiomatic: At that time recommended provincial officers were mostly listed for top selection as clear, diligent, alert, and capable of handling affairs.

sentences.zh: 十一年，諭嗣後保題，務重弓馬漢仗。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, it was ordered that hereafter recommendations must emphasize archery, horsemanship, and Chinese weapons.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, it was ordered that future recommendations must emphasize archery, horsemanship, and Chinese weapons.

sentences.zh: 十五年，以各省所保總兵官鮮當意，諭曰：「年滿千總一項，類多猥瑣。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, because the regional commanders recommended by provinces rarely pleased the emperor, an edict said: The category of battalion commanders at term completion is mostly petty and trivial.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, because recommended regional commanders rarely pleased the emperor, an edict said: "The pool of battalion commanders completing their terms is mostly petty and trivial.

sentences.zh: 國家擢用武職，營伍為正途，拔補將弁，必選之若輩。

translations.literal: The state promotes military officers; the camps are the regular path, and in selecting generals and commanders such men must be chosen.
translations.idiomatic: The state promotes military officers through the camps as the regular path, and in selecting generals and commanders it must draw from such men.

sentences.zh: 緣次而升，皆自年滿千總始。

translations.literal: Promotion by seniority all begins from battalion commanders at term completion.
translations.idiomatic: Promotion by seniority all begins with battalion commanders completing their terms.

sentences.zh: 折衝禦侮之用，豫籌於昇平無事之日，不可視為緩圖。

translations.literal: The use of repelling enemies must be prepared in days of peace and ease—it cannot be treated as a matter to defer.
translations.idiomatic: The capacity to repel enemies must be prepared in days of peace—it cannot be treated as a matter to defer.

sentences.zh: 」二十四年，以大臣自陳例既罷，敕兵部于軍政年，將在京都統、副都統，在外駐防將軍、都統、副都統，各省提督、總兵官，分別三本，條舉事實候鑒裁，以重考績。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, because the grand minister self-criticism rule had been abolished, the Ministry of War was ordered that in the military evaluation year, commanders-in-chief and deputy commanders-in-chief in the capital, garrison generals, commanders-in-chief, and deputy commanders-in-chief outside, and provincial and regional commanders in each province should each submit three memorials listing facts for judgment, to strengthen performance evaluation.
translations.idiomatic: " In the twenty-fourth year, because grand ministers no longer submitted self-criticism, the Ministry of War was ordered that in military evaluation years, capital and provincial commanders-in-chief, garrison generals, provincial commanders, and regional commanders should each submit three memorials listing facts for imperial judgment, to strengthen performance evaluation.

sentences.zh: 四十二年，定衛、所綠營武職薦舉卓異尚未升轉，再遇軍政列平等者，將上次卓異註銷。

translations.literal: In the forty-second year, it was fixed that Green Standard military posts of guards and posts recommended as outstanding but not yet promoted, if in the next military evaluation listed as ordinary, had the previous outstanding rating cancelled.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-second year, it was fixed that Green Standard officers recommended as outstanding but not yet promoted would have that rating cancelled if listed as ordinary in the next military evaluation.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶四年，定侍衛軍政考試，向例軍政年不許告病乞休，以杜規避。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Jiaqing, bodyguard military evaluation examinations were fixed; by precedent in military evaluation years reporting illness or requesting retirement was not permitted, to stop evasion.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Jiaqing, bodyguard military evaluation examinations were fixed. By precedent, reporting illness or requesting retirement in military evaluation years was forbidden to prevent evasion.

sentences.zh: 八年，申諭查閱營伍年分，事關考覈，照軍政例，不得告病、乞休。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, it was reiterated that in years of camp inspection, which concerned evaluation, following military evaluation precedent, reporting illness or requesting retirement was not allowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, it was reiterated that in years of camp inspection, which concerned evaluation, illness reports and retirement requests were forbidden as in military evaluation years.

sentences.zh: 咸、同軍興，百度稍弛，軍政大典，相沿不廢。

translations.literal: In the Xianfeng and Tongzhi military emergencies, many regulations grew lax, yet the great military evaluation ceremony was handed down and not abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: During the Xianfeng and Tongzhi military emergencies, many regulations grew lax, yet the great military evaluation ceremony continued.

sentences.zh: 咸豐二年，黑龍江將軍英隆以俄兵窺伺，派將弁扼守要隘，疏請本年軍政展限舉行。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xianfeng, Heilongjiang General Yinglong, because Russian troops were watching, dispatched officers to hold key passes and memorialized to extend this year's military evaluation.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xianfeng, Heilongjiang General Yinglong, with Russian troops watching the frontier, dispatched officers to hold key passes and memorialized to postpone that year's military evaluation.

sentences.zh: 不允。

translations.literal: The request was not approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was denied.

sentences.zh: 嗣湖廣總督程矞采等以軍務未竣，疏請展限，令凱撤後再行補考。

translations.literal: Later Huguang Governor-General Cheng Yucai and others, because military affairs were unfinished, memorialized for extension, ordering re-examination after victory and withdrawal.
translations.idiomatic: Later Huguang Governor-General Cheng Yucai and others, because military affairs were unfinished, memorialized for extension and ordered re-examination after victory and withdrawal.

sentences.zh: 並諭年老力衰者，隨時參辦。

translations.literal: It was also ordered that the aged and weak might be impeached at any time.
translations.idiomatic: The aged and weak were also to be impeached at any time.

sentences.zh: 沿及德宗，雖加意振飭，勢成弩末，展限之舉，史不絕書。

translations.literal: Down to the Guangxu Emperor, though effort was made to revive discipline, momentum was spent; extensions appear without end in the histories.
translations.idiomatic: Down to the Guangxu Emperor, though effort was made to revive discipline, momentum was spent and extensions appear endlessly in the histories.

sentences.zh: 光緒十四年，編定北洋海軍，由海軍衙門司黜陟。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Guangxu, the Beiyang Navy was organized, with promotion and dismissal managed by the Naval Yamen.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year of Guangxu, the Beiyang Navy was organized, with promotions and dismissals managed by the Naval Yamen.

sentences.zh: 甲午以後，力鑒覆轍，裁綠營，練新軍，別訂考覈章程。

translations.literal: After the Jiawu War, taking hard lesson from repeated failure, the Green Standard was cut, new armies trained, and separate evaluation regulations drawn up.
translations.idiomatic: After the Sino-Japanese War of 1894–1895, taking hard lesson from repeated failure, the court cut the Green Standard, trained new armies, and drew up separate evaluation regulations.

sentences.zh: 三十二年，改兵部為陸軍部，其考覈隸軍衡司。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year, the Ministry of War was changed to the Ministry of the Army; evaluation belonged to the Military Standards Department.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-second year, the Ministry of War became the Ministry of the Army, with evaluation under the Military Standards Department.

sentences.zh: 宣統二年，設海軍部，其考覈隸軍制司。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xuantong, the Ministry of the Navy was established; evaluation belonged to the Military Organization Department.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xuantong, the Ministry of the Navy was established, with evaluation under the Military Organization Department.

sentences.zh: 朝廷銳意革新，軍紀宜可少振。

translations.literal: The court was keen to reform; military discipline ought to revive somewhat.
translations.idiomatic: The court was keen to reform, and military discipline ought to have revived somewhat.

sentences.zh: 無如積習已深，時艱日棘，卒歸罔濟雲。

translations.literal: Yet habits were deeply entrenched, the times grew daily more difficult, and in the end it came to naught.
translations.idiomatic: Yet habits were deeply entrenched, the times grew daily more difficult, and in the end it came to nothing.
